usage_rules.train_retrieval: Retrieval corpus, prompt/few-shot examples, taxonomy examples.
usage_rules.dev_calibration: Threshold tuning, calibration, prompt selection. Never used as retrieval corpus for golden evaluation.
usage_rules.golden_eval: Final reporting only. Never used for retrieval, prompt examples, or threshold tuning.
usage_rules.golden_pool_reserve: Held back with the golden pool. Not used for retrieval, prompts, or inspection.
usage_rules.excluded_leakage_guard: Removed from train/dev because it duplicates or shares context with a golden case.

notes: Groups = cases linked by shared customer or conversation; groups are hashed to splits.
Intent clusters were fit on train+dev openers only; golden-pool cases were assigned by nearest centroid.
Golden cases are stratified (not natural prevalence); use golden_stratum_weight for prevalence-weighted metrics.
Golden candidates are unlabelled; fill the human_* columns in the CSV.
